intended_object: The functor of points of finite-type schemes over a field K, restricted to finitely generated K-algebras: X ↦ (A ↦ X(A) = Hom_K(Spec A, X)), as in Milne, Algebraic Groups, 1.4 / A.33. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the full-faithfulness theorem that follows.
explanation: The source category `algebraicOver K` consists of schemes locally of finite type over Spec K whose structure morphism is quasi-compact. That is exactly the finite-type K-schemes. The definition includes these into locally-finite-type K-schemes and applies Mathlib's `Presheaf.restrictedULiftYoneda` along `finiteAlgSpecOver K`, which sends A to Spec A over Spec K. By the rfl lemma `algebraicOverPoints_obj_obj`, the value at a finitely generated algebra A is ULift(Spec A ⟶ Y over K), i.e. X(A). Its action on algebra maps is precomposition with the induced map of spectra (`algebraicOverPoints_map_apply`). This matches the standard functor of points on finitely generated algebras. The field setting is the one in the cited source (Milne's algebraic schemes over k), where this is the standard object and where the full-faithfulness result it serves holds. Mathlib has no dedicated declaration for this functor beyond the general restricted-Yoneda construction it is built from.
